translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Imi antin-Santiago, Pab Tummadga arpaged-tule tegin Pab-Jesucristoga arpaged-tulebal. Imi antin pemal-Judio-tule-chogambe-kakabogwad iti-napkin-pel-kwapa-pis-pis-mimilesbukwadga karta wis palmijii. Imi antin nued mai.
Kwenadgan igal-pulegangin abin-purtigedbal Pab-neggin olo-kurkin nikunonimalo
Jesúsgin-an-kwenamalad, imi pemalga igal-pulegan akal-akal nonikil, pemal yabli weligwal-itogenabmal.
Tenal pemal pato wismaldo, pemal-wilub-taklenonikil pedin chunchunnad Jesúsgin penzhul, tegin kep pe turdanoniko ukin-ukin abin-purtigal.

Tenal pe ibe-pulegangin ukin-ukin abin-purti-natapil, pemal Pabgin pinzheed-nikunoniko, tegin pe Pab-igal-mamikidbal pel-kwapa immal imanoniko, tegin pe Pabgin immal kwen napijul-kuo Pab-peigujiidyob nanegal.

Imi pemal ampa immal-kwen-wichulil immal imagal, pe Pab Tummadzhe ekisenabmal Pab pirkin-immal-wiis pe-imagal. Tenal pe Pabzhe immal-ekisnail, Pab penik kwen urwojul-kuo, tenal Pabdin pela-pela immal wisgugal pe-imanoniko.

Tenal pe Pabzhe immal-ekisnail, pe Pab-penzhulinab Pab immal-wisgugal pe-imanoniko. Tenal pe melle pinzhemalo, Pab Tummad tule-egin-pengumaladga immal uko. Tenal tule-Pab-pengumalad nigla-ka-purwa-koledbal-akpinnedyob kudimal.
Tenal tule-nigla-ka-akpinnedyob-kudimalad kusgu ilgwen kwen pinzhejulmal.
Kwenamalad, imi pemal tule-pollégwadga kudiil, Pab Tummad tule-tummadga pe-imajadbal pe weligwal itoged-wilubmal.
Tenal pemal-kwenamalad-mani-ibgan Pab-tule-pollégwadga-pe-imakedbal pe weligwal itoged-wilubmalmo. Tenal pe-manidin unnila tud-chunnedyob ku, pulejul pelgunoniko.
Imi tad pela-pela kaalil, tud-chagla tinkudo, e-turpa pél apatido, e-nugu-takleged pelgunonimogo. Tenal tule-mani-ibgan ampa tud-yopí tamalmo, imi mani-e-nikad nue-naojul pelgunonimogo.
Imi pe igal-pulegangin abin-purtijal, pega ib-nuedga kunoniko. Tenal Pab Tummad tule-e-pilalmaladga-kaka-ukchadyob, ilagwen-nadgu pe-otulogo, pega olo-kurkin uklejadyob.
Santiago chogzhagujad immalmal-nuegan pel-kwapa Pab-akar tani
Tenal pe iskuedgin arkwanbi-kualil, pe melle chogo: “Pab Tummad iskuedgin an-egwanbi-kunai.” Tenal Pab Tummad tule-kwen-cholpalmajul immal-akalogal. Tenal Pab immal-akaloed kwen wichul.
Tenal pe iskuedgin arkwanbi-kualil, pe aga tukin immal-akalobied-ulgin, pe iskuedgin arkwanbi-ta, pe aga tukin immal-akalobiedbal pe yardalenonijunno.
Al anmal peyedzhe immal-akalobiedbal, anmalga iskued nononiko. Tenal we iskued pinna-pinna tunkumaichunno, anmal-opurkwedzhe.
Jesúsgin-an-kwenamalad, an-pemal-pilalmalad, imi pemal melle yardalenonimalo immal-akalogal.

Imi immalmal-nuegan tegin immalmal-innikigwad-anmalga-uklejad pel-kwapa nikpa Pab-Tummad-akar tani. Tenal Pab nikpa-neg-otaloged-e-ibed. Al Pabdin tule-egmalyob-chul. Tenal tule-egmaldin purpa-chichiganayob kwage-kwage natapmal. Tenal Pabdin kwen ogwalejul, tegin Pab pane-pane kwen akalgujulbal.
Tenal Pab Tummad e-chunchunnad-chunmakedbal anmal-otulos, anmal-inzhel Pab-pel-kwapa-immalmal-opinnijad-abalgin-kudigugal.
Tule Pab-chogzhad-yopí naneenabmal, tule ual Pab-kaka-itogedginbijul

Kwenamalad-an-pemal-pilalmalad, imi an pemalga wisgal chogdo: imi pemal kuakwa kudimalo pe nuekwa tule-itogal igi chog-dewa. Tenal pe melle yogsal-chogzha immal chogo, tegin pe melle yogasal tulegin urwebalo, tenal pemal nuekwa tule-itogenabgwel.
Tenal tule-urwemalal Pab-immal-nued-imabi-kunaid kwen imajulmal.

Al pemal pel-kwapa igal-iskana ebegenabmal, tule-immal-nunnu-pakal-yapaned-metedyob, tegin pemal igal-iskana-opulamadiid ebegenabmalbal. Tenal Pab-kaka-nuegan-pe-ulubgin-megnonikid pe tummarba-itojulidgin abingeenabmal. Tenal we kakapurwa-nuegan purpal kal nika pemal-abonogal.

Imi pemal melle pinche Pab-kaka-nuegan-itogedginbi nanemalo. Tenal pemal pinche Pab-kaka-nuegan-itogedginbi pe nanemalal, pega ib-nuedga kwen kunonikojul, pedin pinche aga tukin yardanai. Tenal pemal Pab-chogzhadyob pe naneenabmal.
Tenal pemal Pab-kaka-nuegan itogendo, tenal pe Pab-kaka-itojad-pallí kwen nanejulmal. Al pemaldin tule-purtigidgin-aga-wagal-takedyob kunanimal.
Tenal we tule aga purtigidgin wagal takchal, iche wis akpiridel, pato iges-nao e-wagal igi-takle. Al pemal Pab-kaka-choged-pallí kwen nanejulmalal, weob Pab-kaka igenonimalmogo.
Tenal tule Pab-igal-innikigwad-tule-ololcheedgin ukin-ukin kin pinzhenatapil, tegin Pab-igal kwen igeszhulbalil, tenal Pab-igalbal pél immal imakel, we tulega ib-nuedga kunoniko.
Imi pemal chogel: “An Pab-Jesúsbak-inniki-naneed-tule,” tenal pe wichul aga tukin kaka-iskanagin-chunmaked abingeel, pedin aga tukin yardanai. Al pemal Pab-Jesúsbak-naneed ibga kwen kunonikojul.

Tenal tule-Pab-Jesúsbak-immal-akalojulidgin-chwilidik-nanemaladdin nuskan-pabgan-nikchulmalad-akwed, tegin omegan-machered-tarbi-purkwismalad-akwed, tegin tule aga nuekwa taked melle iti-napkined-pinzheedgin aga tukin izhogal.
